title: 第4章  秒杀！
content_zh:
卢长老眸色森冷，“杀你，还不用本长老亲自动手！”
“师尊，我来！”
就在这时，卢长老身后一名弟子站了出来。
“倪仙思，你乃外门第一弟子，是本长老亲自教出来的天才，今日你若能灭了这个宗门叛徒，实为大功一件，本长老会亲自举荐你加入内门！”
“是！师尊！”
倪仙思咧嘴冷笑，看向陆烬时，手中已多出一把青光长剑！
“勾结魔窟的败类，还不束手就擒！”
倪仙思剑光浩荡，一步步走过来，灵珠五重境的修为，出类拔萃，此刻无疑成了全场最瞩目的焦点。
陆烬却摇了摇头，“你先死？”
闻言，倪仙思眸中杀意射出：
话音未落，一剑刺来！
“思你妹！”
陆烬一拳轰出，灵气化作光柱，直接轰碎了倪仙思的脑袋。
一声闷响，长剑落地，清脆悦耳，所有人浑身一颤！
一招，秒杀！
倒抽凉气的声音此起彼伏，所有人眼神惊愕的看着这一幕，全是难以置信！
“什……什么！他竟秒了外门第一！”
“陆烬的气息，竟也是灵珠五重！他居然恢复到灵珠五重了！”
“他不是丹田破碎了么？看来，当初他勾结魔窟之人定是真的，如今怕是修炼了魔功，踏入了魔道！”
“倪仙思大意了啊！他竟死在了同境之人手里，阴沟里翻船！”

“他杀了外门第一天才，卢长老恐怕要暴走了！”
“……”
众人议论声中，卢长老也被这一幕震惊了，显然没想到陆烬居然恢复到了五重！
他怒火翻腾，在自己面前，陆烬竟杀了他的爱徒，这是奇耻大辱！
“陆烬！你敢杀我爱徒！”
“就算你修炼魔功恢复了实力，在本长老七重灵珠境下，你也必死无疑！”
卢长老全身气息迸发，不由分说，直接冲向陆烬！
在他看来，陆烬能杀了倪仙思，却不是他的对手，毕竟灵珠五重与七重之间，差了足足两个境界！
而且一出手他就动用了宗门绝学，剑心掌！
灵气化剑，蕴于掌心，一掌劈出，有断金开石之威！
而面对卢长老的攻击，陆烬却毫不畏惧！
“区区灵珠七重，死！”
面对卢长老的进攻，陆烬直接冲过去，正面应刚！
“什么？他竟敢正面反击！”
“他竟然跟卢长老用的是同一部功法，剑心掌！”
“好快的速度！”
众人震惊间，一声闷响划过，所有人在看到那血腥一幕后，僵在原地，头皮发麻！
卢长老还保持着一拳轰出的姿势，可他的脑袋却已被陆烬一掌斩落，在地上滚了几圈，死不瞑目！
“什么？这怎么可能！”
“他杀了卢长老！！！”

“天啊！速速发传音符给峰主！”
“他不是灵珠五重！他隐藏了实力！连卢长老都能秒杀！”
“……”
现场一片混乱，众弟子心惊肉跳。
而那暗中观战的其他门派强者，也早被陆烬的突然出现惊到了。
不过，他们自然不知陆烬的身份，更是对他五重灵珠境能秒杀卢长老这等强者的手段感到意外。
可也只是有些意外而已，毕竟这种级别的战斗，对他们宗门实力强大，达到金丹境的圣子圣女来说，压根无法构成威胁。
不过，他们倒是乐得看看宗门内斗的热闹，权当消遣。
而此时，陆烬看着自己的手掌，嘴角微微上扬。
这般战力，的确超过了自己的预期！
虽然修炼的都是万剑宗同根同源的武学，可以他如今的灵力催发，所造成的伤害完全凌驾于对方之上！
“还有谁想死，尽管站出来！”
话语铿锵，睥睨全场，看得不少弟子心头发毛！
三年归来，他竟是如此强势，连气度都变了，像一尊杀神，凌厉霸道，锋芒毕露！
没有弟子敢站出来。
哪怕其中有不少内门弟子，甚至还有修为比卢长老还强大的存在，此时也没有站出来。
枪打出头鸟，谁也不想当冤大头，步入卢长老后尘。
此处围观者，绝大多数都是外门弟子，甚至还有一些杂役弟子，真正的内门高手，并不会把时间浪费在围观这种无聊的事情上，有这时间不如去修炼了。
何况，看不出对方真实战力，这才是最可怕的！
看没人说话，陆烬冷笑一声，旋即开口道：

“柳如烟现在何处？”
众人不敢回答，却齐齐转头看向圣女峰方向。
陆烬见状，也看向圣女峰。
既然柳如烟现在已做了圣女，那她一定住在圣女峰！
于是不再逗留，直接朝着圣女峰掠去。
金丹强者才能做到凌空虚度，可如今的他却能凭借非凡手段，凌空滑行百丈之远，再次看呆了一众人等！
“凌空百丈！他的实力，好强！”
“他要去圣女峰，找圣女报仇！”
“可师尊说了，她要在洗髓池为圣女护法，绝不能打搅！”
“陆烬都杀上门了，内门长老都不在山峰，当务之急，先找王凡大师兄！”
“大师兄正在豢兽园驯服紫瞳火尾豹，速发传音符！”
陆烬离开后，围观众人却没有离开，反而一路追赶而去！
此时，万剑宗山林深处，一处灵气弥漫的修行禁地，两道人影走了出来。
“不愧是洗髓池！雷劫之伤三日便已痊愈，徒儿，接下来你便全力以赴冲击二重金丹！”
“多谢师尊为我护法，徒儿一定不负期望！”
姬邀月点了点头，抬眸时却眉头紧皱：
“这三日来，天空雷劫不绝，如今终于散去，不知究竟发生了什么。”
“师尊！”
姬邀月话音刚落，忽然前方一道人影走来，正是她派出去打探消息的弟子。
“师尊，大事不好了！”

姬邀月皱眉：“说！”
“师尊，是陆烬！那引来雷劫之人，正是消失了三年的陆烬！而且，他已经杀了外门卢长老，还有外门第一弟子倪仙思！”
听闻此话，二人面色骤变，满眼难以置信！
“陆烬？他竟没死！”
“不但没死，还有可能得了大机缘，竟能杀了卢长老！”
柳如烟更是意外，自从三年前陆烬失踪后，她可没少追查他的踪迹，想要斩草除根，最终却一无所获。
“没想到，他又回来了，既如此，师尊，这次徒儿一定亲手将他碎尸万段！”
“柳如烟！你今日若不现身，我便掀了你这圣女殿，烧了圣女峰！”
圣女峰上，陆烬傲然而立，宛若化身复仇修罗！
“圣女峰乃宗门重地，你敢在此叫嚣，找死！”
几名弟子出来迎战，个个手中抓着长剑，杀意凛冽。
“今日我找的是柳如烟，与其他人无关，若尔等非要死，我成全你们！”
话落，一股强悍气息弥漫开来，明明灵珠五重境，却有一股让人心悸的威压，一群弟子心头发毛！
几名弟子还要叫嚣，却被之前观战的弟子叫住了，当得知陆烬秒杀了卢长老后，一群人再也不敢妄动。
就在这时，光影闪烁，一道驾驭坐骑的人影闪电般从远处山林间飞来，几个呼吸间，便已来到圣女峰大殿之前！
“王凡师兄，就是他！陆烬，是他杀了卢长老！”
一名弟子冲过去，将陆烬之前所作所为全告知王凡。
“陆烬？你竟没死？”
王凡皱眉。
毕竟陆烬已消失三年，突然出现还有了战力杀了卢长老和外门第一弟子倪仙思，这确实让人意外。

不过他眸中的难以置信却一闪而逝。
“能侥幸杀了卢长老，也算有点能耐。不过，这里可是圣女峰，不是你撒野的地方！”
王凡八重灵珠境，平日极为自负，自然不会将五重境的陆烬放在眼里。
哪怕他杀了卢长老，在他看来，也只是侥幸罢了。
陆烬目光冰冷：
“我只说一遍，此番我来找柳如烟报仇，与其他人无关！”
“若尔等不听劝告，那卢长老便是前车之鉴。”
闻言，王凡胳膊抱在胸前，高高在上的口吻冷笑道：
“你在威胁我？”
陆烬看也不看他：
“你算什么东西？滚！”
霸气外露，却让围观而来的众弟子愤恨不平：
“王凡师兄可是圣女峰第一！万剑宗第三！”
“他可是八重灵珠境，比外门卢长老还强大！”
“陆烬，你胆敢如此蔑视王凡师兄，简直不知死活！”
听着周围一片叫嚣，陆烬面色平静：
“三年过去，什么阿猫阿狗都敢在我面前叫嚣？”
“实力才是真理，既如此，我也只能以理服人了！”
陆烬不打算在这些弟子身上浪费时间，对付这帮自大之人，唯有送出拳头。
“陆烬！你敢骂王凡师兄是狗！”

“王凡师兄，快杀了他！”
王凡身边的弟子叫嚣道，王凡却眯眼冷冷看了他一眼，然后看向陆烬：
“陆烬，若放在以前，我会心甘情愿叫你一声师兄，可是现在么，你也看到了，我已是八重灵珠境，你拿什么跟我斗？”
闻言，陆烬微微摇头叹息：
“王凡，能修炼到这个境界不容易，好好活着不好么？非要装逼？”
王凡冷哼一声，“找死！”
话音未落，人已冲了过来！
灵气缭绕的拳头上，杀意弥漫。
陆烬眼神一眯，身形未动，就这么伸出手掌，灵气都未动用，就抓住了那蕴满灵气的拳头。
大衍化龙诀的锤炼下，他的肉身强度已完全超乎常人！
“什……什么？这怎么可能！”
“他竟直接抓住了王凡师兄的拳头！”
“他好像并未动用灵气！”
众人震惊得张大嘴巴，王凡也大吃一惊，感受到陆烬手上传来的恐怖力道，他欲急速后撤，却被牢牢钳住，无法抽离！
“八重灵珠境，就这？”
陆烬冷哼一声，手掌一用力，“嘭”地一声，王凡灌满灵气的拳头直接炸碎，血肉横飞！
剧痛直冲天灵盖，王凡一声惨叫，可下一秒，声音却卡在嗓子眼。
陆烬扼住他的脖子：
“说，柳如烟在哪。”
content_en:
Elder Lu's eyes were cold, "I don't have to do it myself to kill you!"
"Master, I'm coming!"
At this moment, a disciple behind Elder Lu stood up.
"Ni Xiansi, you are the number one disciple of the outer sect, a genius taught by this elder myself. If you can kill this sect traitor today, it will be a great achievement. I will personally recommend you to join the inner sect!"
"Yes! Master!"
Ni Xiansi grinned and sneered. When he looked at Lu Jin, there was already a green sword in his hand!
"The scum who colluded with the devil's cave will be captured without mercy!"
Ni Xiansi walked over step by step with a mighty sword light. His cultivation at the fifth level of the Lingzhu realm was outstanding, and he was undoubtedly the center of attention at this moment.
Lu Jin shook his head, "You die first?"
Hearing this, Ni Xiansi's eyes shot out with murderous intent:
Before he finished speaking, a sword struck!
"Miss you sister!"
Lu Jin punched out, and his spiritual energy turned into a beam of light, directly smashing Ni Xiansi's head.
With a muffled sound, the long sword fell to the ground. It was crisp and sweet, and everyone trembled!
One move, instant kill!
The sounds of gasping came one after another, and everyone looked at this scene with stunned eyes, all in disbelief!
"What...what! He actually ranked first in the outer sect in seconds!"
"Lu Jin's aura is actually at the fifth level of the spirit bead! He has actually returned to the fifth level of the spirit bead!"
"Isn't his Dantian broken? It seems that it must be true that he colluded with the people in the Demon Cave back then, but now he may have practiced demonic skills and stepped into the demonic path!"
"Ni Xiansi was so careless! He died at the hands of someone in the same situation, and his boat capsized in the gutter!"
"He killed the first genius of the outer sect. Elder Lu is probably going to go berserk!"
"..."
While everyone was talking, Elder Lu was also shocked by this scene. Apparently he didn't expect that Lu Jin would actually return to the fifth level!
He was furious. In front of him, Lu Jin actually killed his beloved disciple. What a shame and humiliation!
"Lu Jin! How dare you kill my beloved disciple!"
"Even if you practice magic and regain your strength, you will definitely die under this elder's seventh-level spiritual bead realm!"
Elder Lu's whole body burst with aura, and without any explanation, he rushed directly towards Lu Jin!
In his opinion, Lu Jin could kill Ni Xiansi, but he was no match for him. After all, there was a gap of two realms between the fifth level and the seventh level of the Lingzhu!
And as soon as he made a move, he used the sect's secret skill, Sword Heart Palm!
The spiritual energy turns into a sword, which is stored in the palm of your hand. When you strike it out with one palm, it has the power to break metal and open stone!
But facing Elder Lu's attack, Lu Jin was not afraid!
"Just the seventh level of the spirit bead, die!"
Facing Elder Lu's attack, Lu Jin rushed over and faced him head-on!
"What? How dare he fight back head-on!"
"He actually uses the same technique as Elder Lu, Sword Heart Palm!"
"What a speed!"
When everyone was shocked, there was a muffled sound. After seeing the bloody scene, everyone froze in place and their scalps were numb!
Elder Lu still maintained his posture of punching out, but his head was cut off by Lu Jin's palm, and he rolled several times on the ground, dying with his eyes open!
"What? How is this possible!"
"He killed Elder Lu!!!"
"Oh my god! Send the transmission notes to the peak master quickly!"
"He is not the fifth level spirit bead! He has hidden his strength! Even Elder Lu can kill him instantly!"
"..."
The scene was in chaos, and all the disciples were terrified.
The other strong men from other sects who were secretly watching the battle were also shocked by Lu Jin's sudden appearance.
However, they naturally didn't know Lu Jin's identity, and they were even more surprised that he was able to instantly kill a powerful person like Elder Lu at the fifth-level spiritual bead level.
But it was just a bit of a surprise. After all, a battle of this level would not pose a threat at all to the saint son and saint, who was a powerful sect and had reached the golden elixir realm.
However, they were happy to watch the excitement of the sect's internal fighting as a pastime.
At this time, Lu Jin looked at his palms and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.
Such combat power indeed exceeded my expectations!
Although those who practice Wanjian Sect have the same roots,The martial arts from the same origin can be activated by his current spiritual power, and the damage caused is completely superior to the opponent!
"If anyone else wants to die, just come forward!"
His words were sonorous and he looked down upon the whole audience, which made many disciples feel very excited!
After returning three years ago, he is so strong that even his demeanor has changed. He is like a murderous god, fierce and domineering, and his sharp edge is revealed!
No disciple dared to stand up.
Even though there were many inner disciples among them, and there were even beings with cultivation levels stronger than Elder Lu, they did not step forward at this time.
No one wants to be taken advantage of and follow in the footsteps of Elder Lu.
Most of the onlookers here are outer sect disciples, and there are even some handyman disciples. Real inner sect masters will not waste their time on such boring things as watching. If you have this time, you might as well practice.
What's more, not being able to see the opponent's true combat power is the scariest thing!
Seeing that no one was speaking, Lu Jin sneered and then said:
"Where is Liu Ruyan now?"
Everyone did not dare to answer, but they all turned their heads to look in the direction of Saintess Peak.
Seeing this, Lu Jin also looked towards Saintess Peak.
Since Liu Ruyan is now a saint, she must live in Saintess Peak!
So he stopped lingering and headed directly towards the Saintess Peak.
Only a strong person with golden elixir can achieve soaring speed, but now he can use extraordinary means to glide a hundred feet in the air, once again astonishing everyone!
"Soaring hundreds of feet into the sky! His strength is so strong!"
"He is going to the Saintess' Peak to seek revenge on the Saintess!"
"But Master said that she will protect the saint in the marrow washing pool and must not be disturbed!"
"Lu Jin has come to kill him, and the elders of the inner sect are not at the mountain. The top priority is to find Senior Brother Wang Fan first!"
"Eldest brother is taming the purple-eyed fire-tailed leopard in the wild animal garden, and he is sending out the telepathic notes quickly!"
After Lu Jin left, the onlookers did not leave, but chased him all the way!
At this time, deep in the Wanjian Sect's mountain forest, in a forbidden spiritual place filled with spiritual energy, two figures came out.
"It is indeed a marrow-washing pool! The injury caused by the thunder tribulation will be healed in three days. Disciple, from now on, you will go all out to attack the second level golden elixir!"
"Thank you, Master, for protecting me. I will live up to my expectations!"
Ji Yaoyue nodded, but when she raised her eyes, she frowned:
"In the past three days, there have been constant thunderstorms in the sky. Now they have finally dissipated. I don't know what happened."
"Master!"
As soon as Ji Yaoyue finished speaking, a figure suddenly walked in front of her. It was the disciple she sent out to find out the news.
"Master, something serious has happened!"
Ji Yaoyue frowned: "Say!"
"Master, it's Lu Jin! The person who caused the thunder disaster is none other than Lu Jin, who has disappeared for three years! Moreover, he has already killed Elder Lu of the outer sect, and Ni Xiansi, the first disciple of the outer sect!"
After hearing this, the expressions of the two people suddenly changed, and their eyes were filled with disbelief!
"Lu Jin? He's not dead!"
"Not only is he not dead, he may also have a great opportunity to kill Elder Lu!"
Liu Ruyan was even more surprised. Since Lu Jin disappeared three years ago, she had been tracking his traces, trying to eradicate the roots, but in the end she found nothing.
"Unexpectedly, he is back again. If so, Master, this time my disciple will definitely cut him into pieces with my own hands!"
"Liu Ruyan! If you don't show up today, I will demolish your Saintess Temple and burn down the Saintess Peak!"
On the Saintess Peak, Lu Jin stood proudly, as if he had become a vengeful Shura!
"Saintess Peak is the important place of the sect. If you dare to shout here, you are seeking death!"
Several disciples came out to fight, each holding a long sword in their hands with murderous intent.
"What I am looking for today is Liu Ruyan. It has nothing to do with anyone else. If you insist on dying, I will help you!"
As soon as he finished speaking, a powerful aura filled the air. He was clearly in the fifth level of the Spiritual Pearl, but there was a heart-stopping coercion that made a group of disciples feel hairy!
Several disciples were still shouting, but they were stopped by the disciples who were watching the battle. After learning that Lu Jin had killed Elder Lu instantly, the group of people no longer dared to act rashly.
Just then, the light and shadow flickered, a figure riding a horse flew from the distant mountains and forests like lightning, and in a few breaths, he had arrived in front of the Saintess' Peak Hall!
"Senior Brother Wang Fan, that's him! Lu Jin, it's him who killed Elder Lu!"
A disciple rushed over and told Wang Fan everything Lu Jin had done before.
"Lu Jin? You're not dead?"
Wang Fan frowned.
After all, Lu Jin had disappeared for three years, and suddenly appeared with the fighting power to kill Elder Lu and the first disciple of the outer sect, Ni Xiansi. This was really surprising.
But the disbelief in his eyes flashed away.
"Being able to kill Elder Lu by chance is considered a bit of skill. However, this is the Saintess' Peak, not a place for you to act wild!"
Wang Fan, who was at the eighth level of the Spiritual Bead Realm, was usually extremely conceited, so he would naturally not take Lu Jin, who was at the fifth level, into consideration.
Even if he killed Elder Lu, in his opinion, it was just a fluke.
Lu Jin's eyes were cold:
"I'm only going to say it once, this time I come to Liu Ruyan for revenge and it has nothing to do with anyone else!"
"If you don't listen to the advice, Elder Lu will be a lesson to you."
Hearing this, Wang Fan crossed his arms over his chest and sneered in a condescending tone:
"Are you threatening me?"
Lu Jin didn't even look at him:
"Who do you think you are? Get out!"
His domineering attitude was revealed, but the disciples who gathered around him felt resentful:
"Senior Brother Wang Fan is number one in Saintess Peak! Number three in Wanjian Sect!"
"He is at the eighth level of the Spiritual Bead Realm and is more powerful than Elder Lu of the Outer Gate!"
"Lu Jin, you dare to despise Senior Brother Wang Fan like this, you are simply desperate!"
Listening to the clamor around him, Lu Jin looked calm:
"Three years have passed and all cats and dogs dare to scream in front of me?"
"Strength is the truth. In this case, I can only convince others with reason!"
Lu Jin did not intend to waste time on these disciples. The only way to deal with these arrogant people was to use fists.
"Lu Jin! How dare you call Senior Brother Wang Fan a dog!"
"Senior Brother Wang Fan, kill him quickly!"
The disciple next to Wang Fan shouted, but Wang Fan narrowed his eyes and gave him a cold look, then looked at Lu Jin:
"Lu Jin, in the past, I would have been willing to call you senior brother, but now, you have also seen that I am already at the eighth level of the Spiritual Bead Realm. What are you going to fight with me for?"
Hearing this, Lu Jin shook his head slightly and sighed:
"Wang Fan, it's not easy to reach this level of cultivation. Why don't you live a good life? Do you have to show off?"
Wang Fan snorted coldly, "Seeking death!"
Before he finished speaking, people rushed over!
